content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: ABIOC(NGFW EAL — Abnormal Recurring Communications to a Rare Domain) AND ABIOC(NGFW EAL — Massive Upload to a Rare Storage or Mail Domain) — fuses the recurring rare-domain HTTPS beacon and the subsequent massive upload from the same NGFW EAL source host (src) into one beacon-then-exfil incident anchored to that shared source host: recurring rare-domain callbacks over 443 lead to a large then massive bytes_sent upload to a fleet-rare storage or mail domain from the same source host, surviving destination/IP rotation that defeats any static IOC.
rules.name: NGFW EAL Rare-Domain Beacon then Massive Upload — ABIOC Causality Stitch
